rule: Every escaped production defect must add or strengthen a defect-class gate.

classes.evidence: Independent surfaces use parent-owned gap; no global sibling-card margin patch.
Persian grouped display, ASCII submit, no duplicate money preview.
User numeric values render Persian before JS.
Real renderer smoke prevents mid-response fatal.
Every ui_icon reference has a symbol.
No raw error.message in normal UI.
Sensitive mutations state target explicitly.
42 cells, 6 rows, arrows plus horizontal swipe.
Human reference and receipt presenter shared across archive/detail/history.
Original/reversal settlements cannot duplicate ledger rows.

classes.owner: server initial state + JS live edit
classes.evidence: JS does not erase valid server-rendered state on load.
Limits are explicit or exports/full views are complete.

classes.owner: critical route + real DB promotion gate
classes.evidence: SQL-sensitive routes execute the production-shaped query on MariaDB/MySQL and authenticated staging before promotion.
Every dismissible bottom sheet, including global tools, supports swipe-down through the shared owner without bypassing dirty-state protection; centered/protected modals do not inherit it.
Every panel time input declares a semantic minute step; schedule=15, event/exact-time=5 unless explicitly justified.

Human time picker displays 1..12 with AM (before noon) on the right and PM (after noon) on the left; numeric grids run LTR; canonical input/API/database value remains 24-hour with explicit 12 AM/PM edge tests.
Calendar action is contained by the composite field at 320/360/390/412 with one focus owner and no overflow.
Tile labels and checkboxes are vertically centered, entire tile is clickable and touch target >=44px.
Date range is day-boundary based; overnight daily windows after midnight use previous scheduled weekday.

Recipients match operational responsibility and URL permissions; event idempotency differs from display tag; one-tap waiter completion and order approval are signed, atomic, audited, and release their active domain guards.
Sensitive browser tests reproduce production component markup/geometry rather than simplified elements-only fixtures.
Reviewed component refinements retire superseded base rules; responsive overrides are intentional and bounded.

classes.owner: subscriber ledger base route + optional enrichment
classes.evidence: Secondary invoice/settlement metadata cannot make the primary subscriber profile route fail.
Consumers call shared confirm/sheet APIs using the documented signature; object-style drift is rejected.
Final promotion cannot PASS when mandatory MariaDB/MySQL or authenticated HTTP probes are unavailable.
User-visible notification test must traverse the same outbox, worker and delivery path as real operational events; direct-send-only tests are insufficient.
Page/section/copy gaps are computed from shared tokens and Browser geometry asserts minimum separation; text blocks may not collapse into one another.
Multi-surface admin pages must declare a shared composition owner or appear in the explicit legacy visual-debt baseline.
Changed critical visual states cannot be promoted Final while their human-reviewed baseline is pending.

A user may see a navigation entry only when the same effective entitlement permits the destination; unknown/stale/failed external entitlement is fail-closed for staff, while explicitly defined admin management access remains separate.

Invoices, subscribers, accommodation and financial periods share one responsive financial vocabulary: compact filters, continuous rows, exception-only status and List→Detail continuity; legacy mobile table/card duplication is rejected.

classes.owner: financial-workspace local tokens / invoice-related-document / financial human-reference
classes.evidence: Financial visual polish derives from active panel tokens; key values and context use semantic hierarchy, related documents have a dedicated owner, human references lead canonical IDs, and the current financial period is not duplicated in history.

classes.owner: panel-core keyboard contract + semantic input markup
classes.evidence: Search/Next/Done Enter semantics are shared, touch Search dismisses after valid action, numeric/decimal/tel keyboards match data purpose, and IME composition Enter is never consumed.

classes.owner: order mutation + inventory outbox + operator/waiter reconciliation
classes.evidence: Committed order/call mutations respond before inventory materialization or full-feed reconciliation; durable outboxes remain recovery truth.
Push fan-out uses bounded concurrency when curl_multi is available, isolates slow devices, and keeps short retryable fast-path timeouts.
Operational outboxes can accelerate after response or through same-origin browser kicks without requiring a worker.
Every queued operational event re-checks domain state and age before provider delivery.
Financial rows with one unambiguous destination are whole-row mouse/keyboard targets while nested utilities remain independent; accommodation/invoice hierarchy leads with human references.
Installed mobile PWA gains one role-aware bottom app navigation and safe-area shell while normal browser/desktop keep the canonical panel navigation.
A newly installed worker never reloads an active operational form automatically; activation is explicit and blocked while dialog/dirty/busy state exists, with one offline fallback owner.
Updater history has one writer, records event code and actor snapshot when available, and write failure is never silently suppressed.
Healthy/running/completed/recovery states have distinct hierarchy; completed progress and repeated success noise are removed, rollback confirmation appears only at decision time.

classes.owner: settlement core transaction + print secondary side-effect
classes.evidence: Financial settlement cannot be rejected solely because the printer destination is disabled or print enqueue fails; print is savepoint-isolated and reported as a secondary warning.

classes.owner: Cafe Center S2S read + Personnel launcher badge
classes.evidence: Cafe receives only Core-authorized count-only payroll attention; failures are fail-silent, no HR detail/persistence is duplicated, and the existing Handoff destination remains unchanged.
Items and categories use one drag/button/keyboard reorder owner; server accepts only the exact current ID set and rewrites order transactionally.
Editable guest copy is searchable/grouped, changed/optional filterable, individually resettable, token-guarded and previewable while system/security copy remains noneditable.
Print Template v2 is declarative/versioned, accepts only the four safe package files, preserves the stable renderer payload contract for Agent 6, and keeps preparation prices forbidden.
58/80 customer receipt and preparation scenarios render through the declared template metadata before activation; physical Agent/driver output remains a separate UAT gate.
Staff order review uses compact continuous rows, direct Trash→Undo in one header slot, silent dine-in default, and exception-only takeaway controls without duplicate badge/editor presentation.

Current bill preserves takeaway quantity as operational exception metadata, hides one-batch disclosure and duplicate subtotal in normal state, and presents printer unavailability as status rather than a dead action.
Multi-unit reductions capture exact prepared removed quantity; only unprepared removed quantity generates preparation reduction and inventory restoration; service items skip preparation.
Audit rows lead with rich action/context, preserve actor snapshots, group dates, support family/search/keyset paging, and no-op mutations do not create fake history.
Every mutating printing admin POST ends in a 303 redirect so browser refresh cannot repeat test/reprint or other mutations.
Print API v4 reservation expiry retries are bounded; exhausted jobs become explicit failed exceptions and manual retry resets the bound deliberately.
Daily UI, notifications, dashboard and preparation print use human order number while canonical O-* reference remains available for audit/search metadata.
Customer preview supports full 80mm columnar and 58mm compact/two-line layouts, prefers Vazirmatn with explicit fallback, while preparation stays quantity-first.
Every mandatory preparation print persists in the same order DB transaction; offline/mapping failure becomes blocked, never missing.
After a durable submission fence/worker launch ambiguity is never automatically reprinted.
Claim/accept/start/renew/report are request-idempotent and attempts have unique durable identity.
Claimed/local jobs survive service restart and ambiguous ownership enters recovery_hold/unknown.
An unresolved older job blocks newer jobs for the same destination/order scope unless human override is audited.
Guest cart styling does not leak back into app.css and Staff cart has one consolidated layout owner; obsolete stacked overrides/state owners are rejected by v1332-cart-owner-contract.py.
Takeaway inheritance is derived from the actual cart: only a truly all-takeaway cart makes a newly added item takeaway; mixed carts return new items to silent dine-in default.

Dine-in stays silent; global fulfillment controls are actions rather than selected-state segments, duplicate badges disappear while an editor is open, and footer exception count appears only when takeaway exists.
Normal mobile staff rows remain compact continuous records with divider ownership and expose fulfillment/note rows only when they carry operational information.

classes.owner: staff-quick-order.js + shared panel confirm + quick-order table picker
classes.evidence: Back is context-aware, draft exit presents visible confirmation, change-table owns vertical scroll and returns without losing draft, and picker open resets scroll.
Choices and Jalali dates inside a task sheet render embedded in that sheet; no second modal/overlay may open behind or above the owning task surface.
390/412 use compact two-column destination/status and date controls while 320/360 remain one-column; primary apply action remains full-width and reachable.
Important actions snapshot stable human context at write time and expose compact expandable details without reconstructing historical facts from mutable live data.
Explicit edit, append/new-draft and conflict-locked states are distinct; stale/terminal edit can never fall through into a new order or append previous items.
Low-stock/deferred/planned/bought never mutate inventory; only inventory receive creates stock movement.
Normal admin UI exposes five work responsibilities, not technical inventory capability grid.
Header close is safe maintenance navigation; disguised logout is not exposed.
Successful normal Quick Order returns to the operational tables workspace with the submitted table opened, refreshed, and the new order identified.
Secondary stepper stays open only for partial takeaway quantities and collapses at zero/all.

Requested, preparing and physically received quantities remain distinct; only physical receipt writes the canonical inventory movement exactly once, with partial receipt allocation preserving true preparing/new remainder.
One open need identity per department/item or provisional name+unit; retries edit the existing need and provisional-to-known conflicts merge instead of duplicating demand.
Guest, Staff and server enforce the same per-item takeaway eligibility; existing items default enabled, ineligible items never become takeaway through bulk actions.
Signed one-tap action token is claimed inside the same transaction as the successful mutation; pre-commit failure remains retryable and review deep-links the exact subject.
Every newly introduced foreign-key target exists before the referencing table is created; MySQL/MariaDB compatibility baseline forbids generated columns.
All settlement destinations validate the same paid-state-aware account signature published by operator feed; legacy invoice-only guard is absent.
Only non-system preparation destinations with zero print_jobs may be physically deleted; system destinations and historical destinations remain auditable.
Waiting jobs surface the earlier unresolved Job that fences the destination; problem blockers are visually distinguished instead of showing only generic pending state.
Primary route has priority; fallback Agent becomes claim-eligible only when primary path is not operational, and fallback Windows queue is snapshotted into the Attempt.

classes.owner: Operator bill correction + quantity-stepper design contract
classes.evidence: Final and prepared quantities share data-bill-step/data-stepper-for and one geometry owner; duplicate prepared handler/geometry is absent.

classes.owner: Print API v4 accept + supported Windows Agent local receipt contract
classes.evidence: Accept validates the actual Agent 6.0/6.1 local receipt format r-<32 hex>; local receipt syntax and content SHA mismatch have distinct error codes and a runtime validator test.
Preparation visibility and actionability are separate; shift supervision/admin monitor globally, preparation mutations remain limited to assigned operational areas.
